title: codegraph.index.synced v1
description: Emitted by adapters/codegraph-sync/sync.py after it runs `codegraph sync` on an opted-in repo (kb config `codegraph.repos`) whose checkout changed. One event per sync attempt, success or failure. Source: /nervous-bus.

path.description: Absolute path of the indexed checkout.

head.description: HEAD commit of the checkout when the change was fingerprinted.

trigger.description: quiescent: the change held still for one timer tick. max_pending: the tree kept moving for 30 minutes.

pending_s.description: Seconds between first seeing the change and syncing it.
